items.title: 68533_Sam Jones oral history interview
items.q: The only thing that the guys over there, you can count on one hand that's doing good. Johnny Griffi N, well he's got a house over there I understand in Holland somewhere, in Belgium somewhere where he lives with his family.

ctx.x: You see and it's hard and they think well we can work more over here. Doing what? What are you doing? They refuse to - when I ask them, I say what are you doing, man. You don't look like nothing you know. You don't look like me. My dungarees is cleaner than yours. You know what I mean. What you got? Show me. The only thing that the guys over there, you can count on one hand that's doing good. Johnny Griffi N, well he's got a house over there I understand in Holland somewhere, in Belgium somewhere where he lives…
Well, Benny Bailey, as long as Benny has been over there...
